implementationFacts: Macro argument collection shares the conditional-directive stack, preserves empty paste operands, treats continued block comments as whitespace, implements __VA_OPT__, and accepts keyword-spelled parameter names.
The -fshort-wchar target profile gives wchar_t and wide literals unsigned-short representation and concatenates narrow and wide literal fragments under the frozen rule.

register declarations, va_list object layout, wide and va_arg lvalues, parameter qualifier compatibility, function-pointer arithmetic, and the GNU escape character use shared type and place authorities.
String literal addresses and address/null comparisons compose into static address constants; initializer plans scale with written entries rather than aggregate extent.
String literals decay before the shared character-pointer signedness conversion in every conversion context.

fullConfigurationSurvey.scopeDiscipline: The survey was measure-only. No newly observed issue was fixed.

singleLinePreprocessedMeasurement.profile: 4149/4155 samples were in Lexer::make_token -> physical_line_col character counting; repeated prefix scans make multi-megabyte one-line inputs quadratic

scopeException.reason: TargetDataLayout is the sole shared layout authority. Duplicating the frozen Y2 layout in parser or interpreter would create a second authority.

processDeviations: The first isolated replay used a temporary Cargo runner that moved test executables away from sibling evo-proofcheck and evo-policy-eval binaries. Those missing-binary failures are rejected. The direct locked offline replay retained target topology and passed.

macOS provenance metadata delayed isolated test artifacts. Only com.apple.provenance xattrs on the isolated target directory were removed before the accepted replay; no source or evidence file changed.
adjacentSpecificationEdges: Y-REGISTER-ADDRESS-DIAGNOSTIC: revision 1.9.53 forbids taking the address of a register object but does not assign its diagnostic code, message, or span.

Y-FUNCTION-POINTER-ARITHMETIC-EXECUTION: revision 1.9.53 admits scale-one function-pointer arithmetic at the front end, while Function provenance elsewhere permits only offset zero and no execution or lowering boundary is assigned.

Y-RANGE-DESIGNATOR-PLAN-COST: revision 1.9.53 bounds initializer-plan cost by written entries, while 10.1.12 still describes expansion to one Index action per selected element. No range-cost claim is made.
claimCeiling: All sixteen declared front-end capabilities pass, the fixed 16-unit dashboard remains 48/48 clean, and all 2,798 enumerated target C translation units complete the integrated raw-source to EvoCPP to parser survey cleanly under the frozen configuration. This is not a general C conformance claim; the diagnostic single-line .i surface remains measured performance debt.
